sv.title: Nyanspolitiker oskyldig
sv.summary: Alla misstankar mot Nyanspolitikern Mehrab Shangezi läggs ner. Han anhölls veckorna före valet, misstänkt för tre olika brott. Nu står det också klart att ingen av de tre assistenter som greps var narkotikapåverkad.

en.title: Newcomer politician found innocent
en.summary: All suspicions against newcomer politician Mehrab Shangezi are being dropped. He was detained weeks before the election, suspected of three different crimes. It has now also become clear that none of the three assistants who were arrested was under the influence of narcotics.
